findings.evidence: Lines 207–211 quantify over ambient sets with membership proofs, lines 285–290 take the stabilizer of `openWeylChamber ... w : Set M`, and lines 297–304 provide only `P.weylGroup ≃ openWeylChambers P b`; there is no `SMul`/`MulAction` declaration for `openWeylChambers`.
findings.fix: Define the induced `MulAction P.weylGroup (openWeylChambers P b)`, prove its coercion/smul lemma and transitivity/freeness (or an equivariant torsor-style equivalence), then state stabilizer results for chamber elements rather than only ambient `Set M`.
findings.issue: `openWeylChambers` is exposed as a subtype, but no Weyl-group action on that subtype is defined; consequently the advertised result is only a bare equivalence plus ambient-set lemmas, not an API through which consumers can state or use simple transitivity on chambers.

findings.evidence: Lines 192–195 define `openWeylChambers` as `Set.range` and give its exact `Iff.rfl` membership restatement without an automation annotation.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `mem_openWeylChambers` (and retain the existential as its normal form).
findings.issue: The defining membership characterization `mem_openWeylChambers` is not tagged `@[simp]`, so simplification cannot reduce membership in the newly exposed range-defined chamber family.

summary: The chamber subtype lacks the action API needed to expose the claimed simply transitive action, and one characteristic membership lemma is not registered for simplification.
